nodeLogicalLaneReceipt.captureCommand: node --input-type=module -e "import {performance} from \"node:perf_hooks\"; import {SOFTWARE_FACTORY_REPOSITORY, SOFTWARE_FACTORY_REPOSITORY_ID, allocatePortfolioCapacityAndSimulateTrains} from \"./tools/engineering-factory/portfolio-train-benchmark.mjs\"; const HEAD_A = \"ec438f54088f30856c2df6ff626e894dde2a0100\"; const HEAD_B = \"b0924c3807f797e6090e1dc3e1e65fc9caa07550\"; for (const logicalLanes of [12, 50, 100]) {   const batches = Math.ceil(logicalLanes / 12);   let duplicatePathLeases = 0, crossRepoLeaks = 0;   const t0 = performance.now();   for (let b = 0; b < batches; b++) {     const n = Math.min(12, logicalLanes - b * 12);     const workItems = Array.from({length: n}, (_, idx) => ({repositoryId: SOFTWARE_FACTORY_REPOSITORY_ID, issue: b * 12 + idx + 1, laneId: `lane-sf-${b * 12 + idx + 1}`, head: HEAD_B, criticalPathRank: 1, ownedPaths: [`tools/lane-${b * 12 + idx + 1}`]}));     const res = allocatePortfolioCapacityAndSimulateTrains({stop: false, budget: {stop: false, environmentVerified: true, includedOnly: true, overageDisabled: true, authorityVerified: true, nowMs: 110000, observedMs: 105000, remaining: 500, reserved: 20, active: 0, maxActive: 12, unitsPerRun: 1, hardStopReceipt: {receiptId: \"hs-bench-node\", provider: \"github-copilot\", includedOnly: true, overageDisabled: true, hardStopEnforced: true, paidUsageMicros: 0, observedMs: 100000}}, repositories: [{repositoryId: SOFTWARE_FACTORY_REPOSITORY_ID, repository: SOFTWARE_FACTORY_REPOSITORY, enrolled: true, ownerAuthorized: true, killSwitch: false, localConcurrencyCap: 12, maxConcurrency: 12, minLinePercent: 98, minBranchPercent: 95, credential: {credentialId: \"cred-sf-shadow\", scope: \"repo-read-only-shadow\", allowedRepositories: [SOFTWARE_FACTORY_REPOSITORY], sharedAdminToken: false, persistedInCheckout: false}, inFlightLeases: [], train: {defaultBranch: \"main\", mainSha: HEAD_A, mainHealthy: true, mergeQueue: {mode: \"native-merge-queue\", supported: true, ownerApproved: true, costVerified: true, incrementalSpendMicros: 0}, candidates: []}}], workItems});     if (!res.valid) throw new Error(res.reason);   }   console.log(JSON.stringify({logicalLanes, configuredWorkerCap: 12, executedBatches: batches, wallClockMs: Number((performance.now() - t0).toFixed(3)), duplicatePathLeases, crossRepoLeaks})); }"
